newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait air cargo rises eight pct in April yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait air cargo rises eight pct in April yr/yr.

text.p: Kuwait airport's April cargo volumes rose eight percent to 12,093 tonnes compared to April 1996, official figures obtained on Wednesday showed.
The figures compiled by the Directorate of Civil Aviation showed a 10 percent increase in passengers to 294,815 which was mainly due to the Moslem pilgrimage season.

Many Kuwaitis and residents of the Gulf Arab states travel to neighbouring Saudi Arabia - home to Islam's two holiest shrines. The date of the pilgrimage changes each calender year in line with the lunar year.
The national flag carrier Kuwait Airways (KAC) handled 72 percent of cargo and 59 percent of passengers in April.
Cargo volumes increased by seven percent in 1996 to 132,879 tonnes for the year and passenger traffic rose by seven percent to 3.6 million.
KAC's 1996 share amounted to 71 percent of cargo and 61 percent of passengers, the figures showed.
